import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_2.csv"
]

# Define target schema columns and their types
target_columns = [
    'fixed acidity', 'volatile acidity', 'citric acid', 'residual sugar', 'chlorides',
    'free sulfur dioxide', 'total sulfur dioxide', 'density', 'pH', 'sulphates',
    'alcohol', 'quality'
]

target_dtypes = {
    'fixed acidity': float,
    'volatile acidity': float,
    'citric acid': float,
    'residual sugar': float,
    'chlorides': float,
    'free sulfur dioxide': int,
    'total sulfur dioxide': int,
    'density': float,
    'pH': float,
    'sulphates': float,
    'alcohol': float,
    'quality': int
}

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns and in the same order
    df = df[target_columns]
    # Convert columns to target dtypes
    for col, dtype in target_dtypes.items():
        if dtype == int:
            # Convert to int safely (some floats might be present, so convert via round then astype)
            df[col] = df[col].round().astype(int)
        else:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(dtype)
    dfs.append(df)

# Perform UNION operation by concatenating all dataframes
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
